youtube.title: Walking Into a Hard Week? Morning Prayer Today | Isaiah 43:2 KJV
youtube.text:
Good morning. Walking into a hard week? This is for you.

"When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee." Isaiah 43:2 (KJV)

He didn't promise you'd never go through it. He promised you wouldn't go through it alone.

Have a blessed day. Type amen, and send this to somebody starting their day.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.

#MorningPrayer #BibleVerse #KJV #BlessedPrayers #shorts
